Reject screen dimensions above Chromium CDP's 10,000,000-pixel limit after resolving target contexts but before mutating mapper configuration.

This prevents a rejected oversized screen override from poisoning later valid viewport commands while preserving target-validation error precedence. Keep the spec-portable checks in WPT and cover Chromium-specific width/height limits, retained screen state, viewport recovery, and invalid target combinations in Chromium BiDi E2E.
